faq: Is Pavurio free?

Yes. Logging care, reminders, the pantry, walks, the health file and widgets are free for one pet. Pavurio Pro adds every pet in your home, realistic coats, weeks and months of history, monthly stories and more care tips.
Does it work for both dogs and cats?
Yes. Each pet has its own look, daily plan, reminders, pantry and history. Cats get litter tracking; dogs get the walk timer.
How does Pavurio know when the food will run out?

When you log a meal, Pavurio takes that portion off the bag you're using. From the last two weeks of meals it works out how much your pet eats a day, then shows the days left and the date to order by. Tap “Why this estimate?” to see exactly how it was worked out.
Do I need an account?

No. Pavurio works on your phone from the first second. Your data is backed up privately to your account so you can restore it on a new phone; you can add Google, Apple or email sign-in whenever you like.
Is there an iPhone app?
Pavurio is on Google Play now. The iPhone app, with Lock Screen widgets and Live Activities, is coming soon.
Which languages does Pavurio speak?
30 languages, including English, Français, Español, Português, Deutsch, Italiano, Nederlands, Polski, Türkçe, العربية, 日本語, 한국어 and 中文.
Is this veterinary advice?
No. Pavurio helps you keep track of the care you give and remember appointments. For anything about your pet's health, talk to your vet.

pet-medication-reminder.title: Pet Medication Reminder App for Dogs & Cats | Pavurio
pet-medication-reminder.desc: Never miss your dog's or cat's medicine. Pavurio reminds you at the right time, lets you mark it given from the notification and follows up if it's still open. Free.
pet-medication-reminder.h1: Pet medication reminders that check back
pet-medication-reminder.lead: Tablets, drops, flea and worming treatments: set the time once and Pavurio makes sure the dose is given, even on busy mornings.
blocks: A reminder at the exact time
Choose the time and how often: every day, a few times a day, or just once. Pavurio schedules the reminder on your phone, so it rings even without a connection.
Tap Done on the notification and the dose is logged for the right pet. No need to open the app.
If a medicine is still open 30 minutes later, Pavurio asks once more. Then it stays quiet.
Know when the box runs out
Link the medicine to your pantry and every dose counts down the pack. Pavurio tells you when to reorder, before the last tablet.
steps: Name, dose and time, in a few taps.
At the time you chose, on every day you chose.
From the notification or the app, in one tap.
faq: Can I set several doses a day?
Yes. Add as many times as you need, each with its own reminder.
What if two people share the pet's care?
Whoever gives the dose marks it done, and the reminder won't follow up. Each dose is logged with its time.
Does the reminder work offline?
Yes. Reminders are scheduled on your phone, so they work without a connection.
Does Pavurio tell me which medicine to give?
No. Pavurio reminds you of the plan you set with your vet. It doesn't give medical advice.

pet-food-tracker.title: Pet Food Tracker: Know When to Buy Dog & Cat Food | Pavurio
pet-food-tracker.desc: Pavurio tracks your pet's food, treats, litter and medicine, forecasts how many days are left and tells you when to order. Shopping list included. Free app, no ads.
pet-food-tracker.h1: A pet food tracker that tells you when to buy
pet-food-tracker.lead: Never stand in front of an empty bag again. Pavurio counts down food, treats, litter and medicine from what your pet really uses, and tells you when to order.
blocks: Days left, worked out for you
Every meal you log comes off the bag you're using. Pavurio averages the last two weeks and shows the days left, the run-out date and the date to order by.
No black box. Tap once to see where the daily amount comes from, which meals were counted and the starting stock.
A shopping list that writes itself
Anything running low lands on the list, with enough packs for the buffer you choose: one week, two weeks or a month. Share it with whoever does the shopping.
Mark a bag as shared and Pavurio counts every pet that eats from it.
steps: Pick a category, enter the pack size and what's left.
Each portion comes off the right bag.
A reminder on the order-by date, and the shopping list ready.
faq: Does Pavurio buy food for me?
No. Nothing is ever bought automatically. Pavurio tells you when to order and how many packs to get.
What if I forget to log some meals?
Pavurio notices quiet days, counts them at your pet's usual rate and marks the forecast as estimated, so the number stays honest.
Can I track litter, treats and medicine too?
Yes. Food and medicine count down from your logs; other products use a simple daily rate like “a pack lasts about a month”.
Does it need barcode scanning?
No. You type the pack size once. No scanning, no paid service, no account needed.

Does it work for cats?
The walk timer is for dogs. Cats get play time and litter tracking instead.
